# LOVABLE MASTER 010 — COMPRAS, FORNECEDORES, RECEBIMENTO, REPOSIÇÃO E INTEGRAÇÃO COM ESTOQUE/CUSTOS/FINANCEIRO

## CONTEXTO

Continue EXATAMENTE o mesmo projeto implementado nos LOVABLE MASTER 001 a 009.

NÃO crie outro projeto.

NÃO recrie módulos existentes.

Antes de implementar:

1. inspecione todo o código atual;
2. leia `docs/handoff/PROJECT-STATE.md`;
3. leia toda documentação de negócio;
4. leia ADRs existentes;
5. identifique migrations aplicadas;
6. reutilize Company;
7. reutilize CompanyRole = SUPPLIER;
8. reutilize Product/ProductVariant;
9. reutilize UnitOfMeasure;
10. reutilize InventoryLocation;
11. reutilize InventoryMovement;
12. reutilize InventoryBatch;
13. reutilize MaterialCostVersion;
14. reutilize AccountPayable;
15. reutilize FinancialCategory;
16. reutilize CostCenter;
17. preserve organization_id;
18. preserve RLS;
19. preserve permissions;
20. preserve Audit Log;
21. preserve idempotência;
22. preserve Domain Events/Outbox;
23. preserve Design System.

Este módulo implementará:

NECESSIDADE
↓
SOLICITAÇÃO DE COMPRA
↓
COTAÇÃO
↓
FORNECEDOR
↓
PEDIDO DE COMPRA
↓
RECEBIMENTO
↓
INSPEÇÃO
↓
INVENTORY LEDGER
↓
CUSTO DE AQUISIÇÃO
↓
COST ENGINE
↓
CONTAS A PAGAR.

---

# 1. REGRA MESTRA

Separar obrigatoriamente:

SOLICITAÇÃO

COTAÇÃO

PEDIDO

RECEBIMENTO

ENTRADA EM ESTOQUE

OBRIGAÇÃO FINANCEIRA

PAGAMENTO.

Esses eventos não são equivalentes.

---

# 2. EXEMPLO

Pedido de compra:

100 kg de material.

Isso NÃO significa:

+100 kg no estoque.

Somente o recebimento físico confirmado poderá produzir entrada no Inventory Ledger.

Da mesma forma:

receber 100 kg

não significa:

fornecedor pago.

---

# 3. FORNECEDORES

Reutilizar:

Company.

Fornecedor deve ser representado através de:

CompanyRole = SUPPLIER.

Não criar cadastro empresarial duplicado.

---

# 4. SUPPLIER PROFILE

Criar:

SupplierProfile

ou equivalente quando necessário.

Campos conceituais:

id
organization_id
company_id
supplier_code
status
default_payment_terms
lead_time_days nullable
minimum_order_value nullable
notes
created_at
updated_at.

---

# 5. MÚLTIPLOS PAPÉIS

Uma mesma Company poderá ser:

SUPPLIER
PARTNER
CUSTOMER

simultaneamente.

Não duplicar empresa por papel.

---

# 6. SUPPLIER PRODUCT

Criar:

SupplierProduct.

Objetivo:

relacionar fornecedor aos itens fornecidos.

Campos:

id
organization_id
supplier_id
variant_id
supplier_sku
supplier_description
purchase_unit_id
conversion_factor quando aplicável
last_price nullable
minimum_order_quantity nullable
lead_time_days nullable
status
created_at.

---

# 7. SKU DO FORNECEDOR

Não assumir:

supplier_sku = internal_sku.

Preservar mapeamento.

---

# 8. UNIDADE DE COMPRA

Fornecedor pode vender:

ROLO.

Estoque/BOM pode trabalhar em:

METRO.

Fornecedor pode vender:

CAIXA.

Estoque pode trabalhar em:

UNIDADE.

Utilizar UnitOfMeasure e conversões oficiais.

---

# 9. NÃO INVENTAR CONVERSÃO

Se:

1 rolo = ? metros

não estiver configurado:

não assumir.

Criar pendência:

UNIT_CONVERSION_MISSING.

---

# 10. PURCHASE REQUEST

Criar:

PurchaseRequest.

Representa necessidade interna.

Campos:

id
organization_id
request_number
request_date
requested_by
department/cost_center_id nullable
status
priority
needed_by_date nullable
notes
created_at
updated_at.

Status:

DRAFT
SUBMITTED
APPROVED
PARTIALLY_ORDERED
ORDERED
CANCELED.

---

# 11. PURCHASE REQUEST ITEM

Criar:

PurchaseRequestItem.

Campos:

id
organization_id
purchase_request_id
variant_id
quantity
unit_of_measure_id
needed_by_date nullable
reason
status
created_at.

---

# 12. ORIGEM DA NECESSIDADE

Preparar:

source_type
source_id.

Exemplos:

MANUAL
LOW_STOCK
PRODUCTION_ORDER
MRP
SALES_DEMAND
OTHER.

Neste módulo MRP avançado ainda não será implementado.

---

# 13. SOLICITAÇÃO MANUAL

Permitir:

COMPRAS
→ SOLICITAÇÕES
→ NOVA SOLICITAÇÃO.

Selecionar:

Item
Quantidade
Unidade
Data necessária
Motivo
Centro de custo.

---

# 14. ESTOQUE MÍNIMO

Reutilizar:

minimum_stock / reorder_point

quando já existir.

Permitir visão:

ITENS ABAIXO DO MÍNIMO.

Isso pode sugerir solicitação.

Não criar pedido automaticamente sem configuração/aprovação.

---

# 15. REORDER POINT

Preparar campos:

minimum_stock
reorder_point
target_stock
safety_stock

quando apropriado.

Não exigir todos na primeira versão.

---

# 16. SUGESTÃO DE COMPRA

Criar função operacional:

suggested_purchase_quantity.

Exemplo simples:

target_stock - available_stock.

Mas apenas quando target_stock estiver configurado.

Não inventar target.

---

# 17. COTAÇÃO

Criar:

RequestForQuotation

ou:

PurchaseQuotation.

Objetivo:

comparar propostas de fornecedores.

---

# 18. QUOTATION

Campos:

id
organization_id
quotation_number
purchase_request_id nullable
status
deadline
created_by
created_at.

Status:

DRAFT
OPEN
UNDER_REVIEW
AWARDED
CLOSED
CANCELED.

---

# 19. QUOTATION SUPPLIER

Permitir incluir múltiplos fornecedores.

Criar estrutura:

QuotationSupplier

e

QuotationSupplierItem

ou equivalente.

---

# 20. DADOS DA PROPOSTA

Por fornecedor/item:

unit_price
quantity
discount
freight
taxes when known
delivery_days
payment_terms
valid_until
notes.

Não inventar impostos.

---

# 21. COMPARAÇÃO

Criar tela comparativa.

Mostrar:

Fornecedor
Preço unitário
Quantidade
Subtotal
Frete
Desconto
Total
Prazo
Condição de pagamento.

Não escolher automaticamente "melhor fornecedor".

Usuário decide.

---

# 22. AWARD

Permitir selecionar proposta vencedora por item ou cotação conforme modelo adotado.

Registrar:

quem decidiu
quando
motivo opcional.

---

# 23. PURCHASE ORDER

Criar:

PurchaseOrder.

Campos conceituais:

id
organization_id
order_number
supplier_id
quotation_id nullable
request_id nullable
status
issue_date
expected_delivery_date
currency
subtotal
discount_amount
freight_amount
tax_amount
other_amount
total_amount
payment_terms
destination_location_id
notes
created_by
approved_by nullable
created_at
updated_at.

---

# 24. STATUS DO PEDIDO

Utilizar:

DRAFT
PENDING_APPROVAL
APPROVED
SENT
PARTIALLY_RECEIVED
RECEIVED
CLOSED
CANCELED.

Não permitir transições arbitrárias.

---

# 25. PURCHASE ORDER ITEM

Campos:

id
organization_id
purchase_order_id
variant_id
supplier_sku nullable
ordered_quantity
received_quantity
purchase_unit_id
inventory_unit_id
conversion_factor
unit_price
discount_amount
tax_amount nullable
line_total
expected_delivery_date nullable
status.

---

# 26. CÁLCULOS FINANCEIROS

Centralizar cálculos server-side.

Não confiar somente no frontend para:

subtotal
desconto
total
saldo a receber
quantidade recebida.

---

# 27. APROVAÇÃO

Preparar fluxo:

DRAFT
→ PENDING_APPROVAL
→ APPROVED.

Permissões separadas.

Não permitir que qualquer usuário aprove seu próprio pedido quando política futura exigir segregação.

---

# 28. ALÇADAS

Preparar configuração futura de aprovação por valor.

Não hardcode valores.

---

# 29. PEDIDO NÃO MOVIMENTA ESTOQUE

Regra obrigatória:

PurchaseOrder APPROVED/SENT

NÃO gera:

InventoryMovement IN.

Somente recebimento físico.

---

# 30. GOODS RECEIPT

Criar:

GoodsReceipt.

Representa recebimento físico.

Campos:

id
organization_id
receipt_number
purchase_order_id
supplier_id
destination_location_id
received_at
received_by
status
supplier_document_number nullable
notes
created_at.

---

# 31. STATUS DO RECEBIMENTO

Utilizar:

DRAFT
UNDER_INSPECTION
ACCEPTED
PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED
REJECTED
POSTED
CANCELED.

---

# 32. GOODS RECEIPT ITEM

Campos:

id
organization_id
goods_receipt_id
purchase_order_item_id
variant_id
received_quantity
accepted_quantity
rejected_quantity
unit_of_measure_id
batch_id nullable
manufacture_date nullable
expiration_date nullable
unit_cost
notes.

---

# 33. RECEBIMENTO PARCIAL

Pedido:

100 kg.

Recebimento 1:

60 kg.

Pedido:

PARTIALLY_RECEIVED.

Recebimento 2:

40 kg.

Pedido:

RECEIVED.

Preservar ambos os recebimentos.

---

# 34. RECEBIMENTO ACIMA DO PEDIDO

Por padrão:

não aceitar silenciosamente.

Exemplo:

Pedido:
100.

Recebido:
110.

Criar:

OVER_RECEIPT.

Permitir conforme configuração/permissão.

---

# 35. RECEBIMENTO ABAIXO

Permitido como parcial.

Não fechar pedido automaticamente enquanto quantidade restante existir, salvo decisão autorizada.

---

# 36. INSPEÇÃO

Permitir informar:

Accepted
Rejected.

Exemplo:

Recebido:
100.

Aceito:
95.

Rejeitado:
5.

Somente quantidade aceita deverá entrar no estoque vendável/operacional apropriado.

---

# 37. MATERIAL REJEITADO

Não colocar automaticamente em estoque normal.

Pode ir para:

QUARANTINE
REJECTED
RETURN_TO_SUPPLIER

conforme estrutura disponível.

---

# 38. INVENTORY MOVEMENT

Ao POSTAR recebimento aceito:

gerar:

movement_type =
PURCHASE_RECEIPT

direction =
IN

location =
destination_location

quantity =
accepted_quantity

reference_type =
GOODS_RECEIPT.

---

# 39. IDEMPOTÊNCIA DO RECEBIMENTO

POSTar GoodsReceipt duas vezes não pode duplicar entrada.

Exemplo:

+100

e depois novamente:

+100.

Resultado correto:

somente +100.

---

# 40. TRANSAÇÃO

Posting deverá ser transacional.

Criar:

receipt state
+
inventory movement
+
batch
+
cost source/event
+
commercial/financial event quando aplicável

de maneira consistente.

---

# 41. LOTES

Quando material controlar lote:

recebimento deverá exigir/permitir:

lot_number
manufacture_date
expiration_date.

Reutilizar InventoryBatch.

---

# 42. VALIDADE

Preparar:

expiration_date.

Não obrigar para todos os produtos.

---

# 43. RASTREABILIDADE

Precisamos navegar:

PurchaseRequest
→ Quotation
→ PurchaseOrder
→ GoodsReceipt
→ InventoryMovement
→ InventoryBatch.

E também:

GoodsReceipt
→ Material Cost
→ Production
→ Product Cost.

---

# 44. CUSTO DE AQUISIÇÃO

O recebimento deverá fornecer fonte real para MaterialCostVersion quando configurado.

Exemplo:

100 metros.

Valor:
R$3.000.

Custo base:
R$30/m.

---

# 45. FRETE DE COMPRA

Preparar política para incorporar ou não frete ao custo de aquisição.

Não assumir automaticamente.

Configuração poderá determinar:

INCLUDE_IN_INVENTORY_COST

ou

EXPENSE_SEPARATELY.

---

# 46. IMPOSTOS DE COMPRA

Não construir motor tributário.

Preservar valores informados quando disponíveis.

Política de incorporação ao custo deve ser configurável/futura.

---

# 47. LANDED COST

Preparar conceito:

LandedCostAllocation.

Custos possíveis:

freight
insurance
handling
other acquisition costs.

Não implementar rateio complexo se não houver necessidade imediata.

---

# 48. RATEIO

Quando implementado, permitir métodos:

BY_QUANTITY
BY_VALUE
BY_WEIGHT
MANUAL.

Não escolher método arbitrariamente.

---

# 49. MATERIAL COST VERSION

Ao confirmar custo elegível:

criar nova fonte/versionamento.

Não sobrescrever custo histórico.

Exemplo:

Compra anterior:
R$30/m.

Nova compra:
R$36/m.

Preservar ambas.

---

# 50. COSTING METHOD

Se organização utiliza:

LAST_PURCHASE

o novo recebimento poderá atualizar custo vigente.

Se utiliza:

STANDARD

não deve alterar automaticamente o custo padrão.

Se utiliza:

AVERAGE

aplicar fórmula definida.

Não misturar métodos.

---

# 51. CUSTO MÉDIO

Se implementado:

calcular server-side e documentar fórmula.

Preservar dados necessários para auditoria.

---

# 52. IMPACTO NO PRODUCT COST

Mudança do custo de matéria-prima não deve reescrever automaticamente ProductCostVersion histórico.

Pode gerar:

PRODUCT_COST_RECALCULATION_AVAILABLE.

---

# 53. EVENTO

Ao postar recebimento:

emitir quando apropriado:

GOODS_RECEIPT_POSTED.

Esse evento poderá alimentar:

Cost Engine
Financeiro
Analytics.

---

# 54. OBRIGAÇÃO FINANCEIRA

Pedido não deve gerar automaticamente pagamento realizado.

Dependendo da política, AccountPayable poderá ser criado a partir de:

PurchaseOrder aprovado

ou preferencialmente:

GoodsReceipt / Supplier Document.

Para primeira versão, priorizar evento de recebimento/documento confirmado.

Documentar a decisão.

---

# 55. ACCOUNT PAYABLE

Ao gerar obrigação:

relacionar:

source_type =
PURCHASE / GOODS_RECEIPT

source_id.

Evitar duplicidade.

---

# 56. VALOR A PAGAR

Usar valor confirmado da obrigação/documento.

Não assumir cegamente que:

PurchaseOrder total

sempre será igual ao documento recebido.

Pode haver:

recebimento parcial
frete
desconto
diferença
imposto.

---

# 57. PARCELAMENTO

PaymentTerms poderá gerar:

1 ou várias parcelas.

Exemplo:

30/60/90.

Gerar AccountPayables relacionados à mesma origem.

---

# 58. IDEMPOTÊNCIA FINANCEIRA

Mesmo GoodsReceipt/documento não pode gerar títulos duplicados após retry.

---

# 59. DOCUMENTO DO FORNECEDOR

Preparar:

SupplierDocument.

Campos:

id
organization_id
supplier_id
document_type
document_number
issue_date
total_amount
purchase_order_id nullable

    IF v_status IN ('POSTED','CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Item de recebimento imutável após postagem.'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='supplier_returns' AND OLD.status IN ('POSTED','CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Devolução postada/cancelada é imutável.'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='supplier_return_items' THEN
    SELECT status INTO v_status FROM public.supplier_returns WHERE id=(j->>'supplier_return_id')::uuid;
    IF v_status IN ('POSTED','CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Item de devolução imutável após postagem.'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='supplier_documents' AND OLD.status IN ('PROCESSED','CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Documento processado/cancelado é imutável.'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='purchase_orders' AND OLD.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido concluído/cancelado é imutável.'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='purchase_exceptions' AND OLD.status IN ('RESOLVED','IGNORED_WITH_AUTHORIZATION') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exceção resolvida é imutável.'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.supplier_query(_org uuid,_kind text,_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}',_page integer DEFAULT 1)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE result jsonb; query text:=lower(coalesce(_filters->>'query','')); status text:=coalesce(_filters->>'status','');
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.purchasing_require(_org,'suppliers.read');
  IF _kind='suppliers' THEN
    WITH s AS (
      SELECT c.id company_id,c.code,c.legal_name,c.trade_name,c.document_type,c.document_number,c.status company_status,
        p.id supplier_id,p.supplier_code,p.status,p.default_payment_terms,p.preferred,p.currency,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.supplier_products sp WHERE sp.supplier_id=p.id AND sp.status='ACTIVE') product_count,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.purchase_orders po WHERE po.supplier_id=p.id AND po.status IN ('APPROVED','SENT','RECEIVING')) open_orders
      FROM public.companies c JOIN public.supplier_profiles p ON p.company_id=c.id
      WHERE c.organization_id=_org
      )
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)) FROM (SELECT * FROM s WHERE (query='' OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',code,legal_name,trade_name,supplier_code,document_number)),query)>0) AND (status='' OR p_status=status) ORDER BY legal_name LIMIT 50 OFFSET (_page-1)*50) q), '[]'::jsonb),'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM s)) INTO result;
  ELSIF _kind='supplier' THEN
    SELECT to_jsonb(c)||jsonb_build_object(
      'profile',(SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM public.supplier_profiles p WHERE p.organization_id=_org AND c.id=p.company_id),
      'products',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(sp)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.supplier_products sp JOIN public.product_variants v ON v.id=sp.variant_id JOIN public.products pr ON pr.id=v.product_id WHERE sp.supplier_id=c.supplier_profiles_id),
      'orders',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(o),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT po.id,po.order_number,po.status,po.issue_date,po.expected_delivery_date,po.total_amount,po.currency FROM public.purchase_orders po WHERE po.supplier_id=c.supplier_profiles_id ORDER BY po.created_at DESC LIMIT 20) o),
      'receipts',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(r),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT gr.id,gr.receipt_number,gr.status,gr.received_at,gr.total_accepted FROM public.goods_receipts gr WHERE gr.supplier_id=c.supplier_profiles_id ORDER BY gr.created_at DESC LIMIT 20) r),
      'documents',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(d),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT sd.id,sd.document_type,sd.document_number,sd.issue_date,sd.total_amount,sd.status FROM public.supplier_documents sd WHERE sd.supplier_id=c.supplier_profiles_id ORDER BY sd.created_at DESC LIMIT 20) d),
      'returns',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(t),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT sr.id,sr.return_number,sr.status,sr.return_date FROM public.supplier_returns sr WHERE sr.supplier_id=c.supplier_profiles_id ORDER BY sr.created_at DESC LIMIT 20) t)
    ) INTO result FROM (SELECT c.*,s.id supplier_profiles_id FROM public.companies c JOIN public.supplier_profiles s ON s.company_id=c.id WHERE c.organization_id=_org AND c.id=(coalesce(nullif(_filters->>'company_id',''),nullif(_filters->>'id',''))::uuid)) c;
    IF result IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Fornecedor não encontrado.'; END IF;
    result:=result::jsonb||jsonb_build_object('payables',CASE WHEN public.has_permission(_org,'payables.read') THEN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(p),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT ap.id,ap.document_number,ap.source_type,ap.issue_date,ap.due_date,ap.original_amount,ap.open_amount,ap.status,ap.installment_number,ap.total_installments FROM public.account_payables ap WHERE ap.company_id=(result->>'id')::uuid AND ap.organization_id=_org ORDER BY ap.due_date) p) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END);
  ELSIF _kind='products' THEN
    WITH rows AS MATERIALIZED(
      SELECT sp.id,sp.supplier_id,c.legal_name supplier_name,sp.variant_id,v.sku,pr.name product_name,sp.supplier_sku,sp.supplier_description,
        u.code purchase_unit,ui.code inventory_unit,sp.conversion_factor,sp.last_price,sp.last_price_date,sp.minimum_order_quantity,sp.lead_time_days,sp.status
      FROM public.supplier_products sp JOIN public.supplier_profiles s ON s.id=sp.supplier_id JOIN public.companies c ON c.id=s.company_id
      JOIN public.product_variants v ON v.id=sp.variant_id JOIN public.products pr ON pr.id=v.product_id
      LEFT JOIN public.units_of_measure u ON u.id=sp.purchase_unit_id LEFT JOIN public.units_of_measure ui ON ui.id=sp.inventory_unit_id
      WHERE sp.organization_id=_org AND (nullif(_filters->>'supplier_id','') IS NULL OR sp.supplier_id=(_filters->>'supplier_id')::uuid)
        AND (query='' OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',c.legal_name,sp.supplier_sku,v.sku,pr.name)),query)>0))
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)) FROM (SELECT * FROM rows ORDER BY supplier_name LIMIT 100 OFFSET (_page-1)*100) q),'[]'::jsonb),'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM rows)) INTO result;
  ELSIF _kind='dashboard' THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'active_suppliers',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.supplier_profiles WHERE organization_id=_org AND status='ACTIVE'),
      'products_catalogued',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.supplier_products WHERE organization_id=_org AND status='ACTIVE'),
      'open_orders',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE organization_id=_org AND status IN ('APPROVED','SENT','RECEIVING')),
      'unmatched_documents',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.supplier_documents WHERE organization_id=_org AND status IN ('DRAFT','EXCEPTION')),
      'open_exceptions',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.purchase_exceptions WHERE organization_id=_org AND status IN ('OPEN','IN_REVIEW'))) INTO result;
  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Consulta inválida.'; END IF;
  RETURN result;
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.request_save(_org uuid,_data jsonb,_id uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE v uuid:=coalesce(_id,gen_random_uuid()); it jsonb; v_qty numeric;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.purchasing_require(_org,'purchase_requests.create');
  IF _data->'items' IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(_data->'items')=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Informe ao menos um item.'; END IF;
  IF _id IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.purchase_requests(organization_id,request_number,request_date,requested_by,cost_center_id,status,priority,needed_by_date,notes)
    VALUES(_org,'REQ-'||to_char(now(),'YYYY')||'-'||lpad(nextval('public.purchase_request_seq')::text,6,'0'),coalesce(nullif(_data->>'request_date','')::date,CURRENT_DATE),auth.uid(),nullif(_data->>'cost_center_id','')::uuid,'DRAFT',coalesce(_data->>'priority','NORMAL'),nullif(_data->>'needed_by_date','')::date,_data->>'notes') RETURNING id INTO v;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.purchase_requests SET cost_center_id=coalesce(nullif(_data->>'cost_center_id','')::uuid,cost_center_id),priority=coalesce(_data->>'priority',priority),needed_by_date=coalesce(nullif(_data->>'needed_by_date','')::date,needed_by_date),notes=coalesce(_data->>'notes',notes),updated_at=now() WHERE id=v AND organization_id=_org AND status='DRAFT';
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Requisição não encontrada ou já encaminhada.'; END IF;
    DELETE FROM public.purchase_request_items WHERE purchase_request_id=v;
  END IF;
  FOR it IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(_data->'items')
  LOOP
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.product_variants WHERE id=(it->>'variant_id')::uuid AND organization_id=_org) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Variante inválida.'; END IF;
    v_qty:=(it->>'quantity')::numeric;
    IF v_qty<=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quantidade inválida.'; END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.purchase_request_items(organization_id,purchase_request_id,variant_id,quantity,unit_of_measure_id,needed_by_date,reason,source_type,source_id,status)
    VALUES(_org,v,(it->>'variant_id')::uuid,v_qty,nullif(it->>'unit_of_measure_id','')::uuid,nullif(it->>'needed_by_date','')::date,it->>'reason',coalesce(it->>'source_type','MANUAL'),it->>'source_id','PENDING');
  END LOOP;
  PERFORM public.purchasing_audit(_org,CASE WHEN _id IS NULL THEN 'purchasing.request.create' ELSE 'purchasing.request.update' END,'purchase_requests',v,_data);
  RETURN v;
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.request_action(_org uuid,_id uuid,_action text,_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}') RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE v_status text; r public.purchase_requests; n text;
BEGIN
  IF _action NOT IN ('submit','approve','cancel') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ação inválida.'; END IF;
  PERFORM public.purchasing_require(_org,CASE _action WHEN 'approve' THEN 'purchase_requests.approve' WHEN 'cancel' THEN 'purchase_requests.cancel' ELSE 'purchase_requests.create' END);
  PERFORM public.inventory_lock(_org);
  SELECT * INTO r FROM public.purchase_requests WHERE id=_id AND organization_id=_org FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Requisição não encontrada.'; END IF;
  v_status:=r.status;
  IF _action='submit' THEN
    IF v_status<>'DRAFT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Somente rascunhos podem ser submetidos.'; END IF;
    UPDATE public.purchase_requests SET status='SUBMITTED' WHERE id=_id;
  ELSIF _action='approve' THEN
    IF v_status NOT IN ('SUBMITTED','APPROVED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Somente requisições submetidas podem ser aprovadas.'; END IF;
    UPDATE public.purchase_requests SET status='APPROVED' WHERE id=_id;
  ELSIF _action='cancel' THEN
    IF v_status IN ('ORDERED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Requisição já transformada em pedido não pode ser cancelada.'; END IF;
    UPDATE public.purchase_requests SET status='CANCELED' WHERE id=_id;
    UPDATE public.purchase_request_items SET status='CANCELLED' WHERE purchase_request_id=_id AND status='PENDING';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.purchasing_audit(_org,'purchasing.request.'||_action,'purchase_requests',_id,_data);
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id',_id,'status',CASE _action WHEN 'submit' THEN 'SUBMITTED' WHEN 'approve' THEN 'APPROVED' ELSE 'CANCELED' END);
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.request_query(_org uuid,_kind text,_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}',_page integer DEFAULT 1)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE result jsonb; query text:=lower(coalesce(_filters->>'query','')); status text:=coalesce(_filters->>'status','');
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.purchasing_require(_org,'purchase_requests.read');
  IF _kind='requests' THEN
    WITH rows AS MATERIALIZED(
      SELECT r.id,r.request_number,r.request_date,r.status,r.priority,r.needed_by_date,cc.name cost_center,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.purchase_request_items i WHERE i.purchase_request_id=r.id) items,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.purchase_request_items i WHERE i.purchase_request_id=r.id AND i.status='PENDING') pending_items,
        profile.first_name||' '||profile.last_name requested_name
      FROM public.purchase_requests r LEFT JOIN public.cost_centers cc ON cc.id=r.cost_center_id
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles profile ON profile.id=r.requested_by
      WHERE r.organization_id=_org)
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)) FROM (SELECT * FROM rows WHERE (query='' OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',request_number,coalesce(cost_center,''))),query)>0) AND (status='' OR status=str_status) ORDER BY request_date DESC,request_number DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET (_page-1)*50) q),'[]'::jsonb),'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM rows)) INTO result;
  ELSIF _kind='request' THEN
    result:=jsonb_build_object('request',(SELECT to_jsonb(r) FROM public.purchase_requests r WHERE id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid AND organization_id=_org),
      'items',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.purchase_request_items i WHERE i.purchase_request_id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid));
  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Consulta inválida.'; END IF;
  RETURN result;
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.quotation_save(_org uuid,_data jsonb,_id uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE v uuid:=coalesce(_id,gen_random_uuid()); supp jsonb; it jsonb; s_id uuid; v_qty numeric; v_price numeric;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.purchasing_require(_org,'quotations.create');
  IF _data->'suppliers' IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(_data->'suppliers')=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Informe ao menos um fornecedor.'; END IF;
  IF _id IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.quotations(organization_id,quotation_number,purchase_request_id,status,deadline,notes,created_by)
    VALUES(_org,'COT-'||to_char(now(),'YYYY')||'-'||lpad(nextval('public.quotation_seq')::text,6,'0'),nullif(_data->>'purchase_request_id','')::uuid,'DRAFT',nullif(_data->>'deadline','')::date,_data->>'notes',auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO v;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.quotations SET purchase_request_id=coalesce(nullif(_data->>'purchase_request_id','')::uuid,purchase_request_id),deadline=coalesce(nullif(_data->>'deadline','')::date,deadline),notes=coalesce(_data->>'notes',notes),updated_at=now() WHERE id=v AND organization_id=_org AND status IN ('DRAFT','AWAITING');
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cotação não encontrada ou já encerrada.'; END IF;
    DELETE FROM public.quotation_suppliers WHERE quotation_id=v;
    DELETE FROM public.quotation_supplier_items WHERE quotation_id=v;
  END IF;
  FOR supp IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(_data->'suppliers')
  LOOP
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_profiles WHERE id=(supp->>'supplier_id')::uuid AND organization_id=_org) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Fornecedor inválido.'; END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.quotation_suppliers(organization_id,quotation_id,supplier_id,notes) VALUES(_org,v,(supp->>'supplier_id')::uuid,supp->>'notes');
    FOR it IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(supp->'items','[]'::jsonb))
    LOOP
      v_qty:=(it->>'quantity')::numeric; v_price:=(it->>'unit_price')::numeric;
      IF v_qty<=0 OR v_price<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Item de cotação inválido.'; END IF;
      INSERT INTO public.quotation_supplier_items(organization_id,quotation_id,supplier_id,purchase_request_item_id,variant_id,quantity,unit_of_measure_id,unit_price,discount_amount,freight_amount,tax_amount,other_amount,total_amount,delivery_days,payment_terms,valid_until,notes)
      VALUES(_org,v,(supp->>'supplier_id')::uuid,nullif(it->>'purchase_request_item_id','')::uuid,(it->>'variant_id')::uuid,v_qty,nullif(it->>'unit_of_measure_id','')::uuid,v_price,coalesce((it->>'discount_amount')::numeric,0),coalesce((it->>'freight_amount')::numeric,0),coalesce((it->>'tax_amount')::numeric,0),coalesce((it->>'other_amount')::numeric,0),
        round(v_qty*v_price - coalesce((it->>'discount_amount')::numeric,0) + coalesce((it->>'freight_amount')::numeric,0) + coalesce((it->>'tax_amount')::numeric,0) + coalesce((it->>'other_amount')::numeric,0),6),
        nullif((it->>'delivery_days')::int::text,'')::int,it->>'payment_terms',nullif(it->>'valid_until','')::date,it->>'notes');
    END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
  UPDATE public.quotations SET status='AWAITING' WHERE id=v AND status='DRAFT';
  PERFORM public.purchasing_audit(_org,CASE WHEN _id IS NULL THEN 'purchasing.quotation.create' ELSE 'purchasing.quotation.update' END,'quotations',v,_data);
  RETURN v;
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.quotation_award(_org uuid,_quotation_id uuid,_data jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE it jsonb; v_award boolean; v_id uuid; v_variant uuid; v_supplier uuid;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.purchasing_require(_org,'quotations.award');
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.quotations WHERE id=_quotation_id AND organization_id=_org) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cotação não encontrada.'; END IF;
  FOR it IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(_data->'items')
  LOOP
    v_id:=(it->>'item_id')::uuid; v_award:=coalesce((it->>'award')::boolean,false);
    IF v_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      UPDATE public.quotation_supplier_items SET awarded=v_award,awarded_by=CASE WHEN v_award THEN auth.uid() END,awarded_at=CASE WHEN v_award THEN now() END,award_reason=CASE WHEN v_award THEN it->>'reason' ELSE NULL END
      WHERE id=v_id AND organization_id=_org AND quotation_id=_quotation_id;
      IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Item de cotação não encontrado.'; END IF;
    ELSIF v_award THEN
      v_variant:=(it->>'variant_id')::uuid; v_supplier:=(it->>'supplier_id')::uuid;
      UPDATE public.quotation_supplier_items SET awarded=true,awarded_by=auth.uid(),awarded_at=now(),award_reason=coalesce(it->>'reason','Selecionado na cotação')
      WHERE organization_id=_org AND quotation_id=_quotation_id AND supplier_id=v_supplier AND variant_id=v_variant;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  UPDATE public.quotations SET status=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.quotation_supplier_items WHERE quotation_id=_quotation_id AND awarded) THEN 'AWARDED' ELSE status END WHERE id=_quotation_id;
  PERFORM public.purchasing_audit(_org,'purchasing.quotation.award','quotations',_quotation_id,_data);
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('quotation_id',_quotation_id,'awarded',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.quotation_supplier_items WHERE quotation_id=_quotation_id AND awarded));
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.quotation_query(_org uuid,_kind text,_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}',_page integer DEFAULT 1)

  ELSIF _kind='quotation' THEN
    WITH q AS (SELECT * FROM public.quotations WHERE id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid AND organization_id=_org)
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('quotation',(SELECT to_jsonb(q) FROM q),
      'suppliers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(s),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT qs.id,qs.supplier_id,qs.notes,c.legal_name supplier_name,c.document_number,c.document_type FROM public.quotation_suppliers qs JOIN public.supplier_profiles sp ON sp.id=qs.supplier_id JOIN public.companies c ON c.id=sp.company_id WHERE qs.quotation_id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid ORDER BY c.legal_name) s),
      'items',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(i),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT qsi.id,qsi.supplier_id,qsi.variant_id,qsi.quantity,qsi.unit_price,qsi.discount_amount,qsi.freight_amount,qsi.tax_amount,qsi.other_amount,qsi.total_amount,qsi.delivery_days,qsi.payment_terms,qsi.valid_until,qsi.awarded,qsi.award_reason,c.legal_name supplier_name,v.sku,pr.name product_name FROM public.quotation_supplier_items qsi JOIN public.supplier_profiles sp ON sp.id=qsi.supplier_id JOIN public.companies c ON c.id=sp.company_id JOIN public.product_variants v ON v.id=qsi.variant_id JOIN public.products pr ON pr.id=v.product_id WHERE qsi.quotation_id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid ORDER BY v.sku,c.legal_name) i)) INTO result;

$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.po_save(_org uuid,_data jsonb,_id uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE v uuid:=coalesce(_id,gen_random_uuid()); it jsonb; v_qty numeric; v_price numeric; v_sub numeric:=0; v_line numeric; v_supplier uuid;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.purchasing_require(_org,'purchase_orders.create');
  if _data->'items' IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(_data->'items')=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Informe ao menos um item.'; END IF;
  v_supplier:=coalesce(nullif(_data->>'supplier_id','')::uuid,(SELECT supplier_id FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id=v));
  IF v_supplier IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_profiles WHERE id=v_supplier AND organization_id=_org AND status='ACTIVE') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Fornecedor ativo obrigatório.'; END IF;
  IF _id IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.purchase_orders(organization_id,order_number,supplier_id,quotation_id,purchase_request_id,status,issue_date,expected_delivery_date,currency,payment_terms,destination_location_id,financial_category_id,cost_center_id,notes,created_by)
    VALUES(_org,'PO-'||to_char(now(),'YYYY')||'-'||lpad(nextval('public.purchase_order_seq')::text,6,'0'),v_supplier,nullif(_data->>'quotation_id','')::uuid,nullif(_data->>'purchase_request_id','')::uuid,'DRAFT',coalesce(nullif(_data->>'issue_date','')::date,CURRENT_DATE),nullif(_data->>'expected_delivery_date','')::date,coalesce(_data->>'currency','BRL'),_data->>'payment_terms',nullif(_data->>'destination_location_id','')::uuid,nullif(_data->>'financial_category_id','')::uuid,nullif(_data->>'cost_center_id','')::uuid,_data->>'notes',auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO v;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.purchase_orders SET supplier_id=v_supplier,expected_delivery_date=coalesce(nullif(_data->>'expected_delivery_date','')::date,expected_delivery_date),currency=coalesce(_data->>'currency',currency),payment_terms=coalesce(_data->>'payment_terms',payment_terms),destination_location_id=coalesce(nullif(_data->>'destination_location_id','')::uuid,destination_location_id),financial_category_id=coalesce(nullif(_data->>'financial_category_id','')::uuid,financial_category_id),cost_center_id=coalesce(nullif(_data->>'cost_center_id','')::uuid,cost_center_id),notes=coalesce(_data->>'notes',notes),updated_at=now() WHERE id=v AND organization_id=_org AND status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED');
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido não encontrado ou não editável.'; END IF;
    DELETE FROM public.purchase_order_items WHERE purchase_order_id=v;
  END IF;
  FOR it IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(_data->'items')
  LOOP
    v_qty:=(it->>'ordered_quantity')::numeric; v_price:=(it->>'unit_price')::numeric;
    IF v_qty<=0 OR v_price<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Item de pedido inválido.'; END IF;
    v_line:=round(v_qty*v_price,2); v_sub:=v_sub+v_line;
    INSERT INTO public.purchase_order_items(organization_id,purchase_order_id,variant_id,supplier_sku,ordered_quantity,purchase_unit_id,inventory_unit_id,conversion_factor,unit_price,discount_amount,tax_amount,line_total,expected_delivery_date,status)
    VALUES(_org,v,(it->>'variant_id')::uuid,it->>'supplier_sku',v_qty,nullif(it->>'purchase_unit_id','')::uuid,coalesce(nullif(it->>'inventory_unit_id','')::uuid,(SELECT w.unit_of_measure_id FROM public.product_variants w WHERE w.id=(it->>'variant_id')::uuid)),coalesce((it->>'conversion_factor')::numeric,NULL),v_price,coalesce((it->>'discount_amount')::numeric,0),coalesce((it->>'tax_amount')::numeric,0),v_line,nullif(it->>'expected_delivery_date','')::date,'OPEN');
  END LOOP;
  UPDATE public.purchase_orders SET subtotal=v_sub,discount_amount=coalesce((_data->>'discount_amount')::numeric,0),freight_amount=coalesce((_data->>'freight_amount')::numeric,0),tax_amount=coalesce((_data->>'tax_amount')::numeric,0),other_amount=coalesce((_data->>'other_amount')::numeric,0),
    total_amount=round(v_sub - coalesce((_data->>'discount_amount')::numeric,0) + coalesce((_data->>'freight_amount')::numeric,0) + coalesce((_data->>'tax_amount')::numeric,0) + coalesce((_data->>'other_amount')::numeric,0),2)
    WHERE id=v;
  PERFORM public.purchasing_audit(_org,CASE WHEN _id IS NULL THEN 'purchasing.order.create' ELSE 'purchasing.order.update' END,'purchase_orders',v,_data);
  RETURN v;
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.po_action(_org uuid,_id uuid,_action text,_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}') RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE o public.purchase_orders; v_segregation boolean;
BEGIN
  IF _action NOT IN ('submit','approve','send','cancel') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ação inválida.'; END IF;
  PERFORM public.purchasing_require(_org,CASE _action
    WHEN 'approve' THEN 'purchase_orders.approve'
    WHEN 'send' THEN 'purchase_orders.send'
    WHEN 'cancel' THEN 'purchase_orders.cancel'
    ELSE 'purchase_orders.create' END);
  PERFORM public.inventory_lock(_org);
  SELECT * INTO o FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id=_id AND organization_id=_org FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido não encontrado.'; END IF;
  IF _action='submit' THEN
    IF o.status<>'DRAFT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Somente rascunhos podem ser submetidos.'; END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_order_items WHERE purchase_order_id=_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido sem itens.'; END IF;
    UPDATE public.purchase_orders SET status='PENDING_APPROVAL' WHERE id=_id;
  ELSIF _action='approve' THEN
    IF o.status NOT IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Somente pedidos aguardando aprovação.'; END IF;
    PERFORM public.purchasing_ensure_settings(_org);
    SELECT approval_segregation INTO v_segregation FROM public.purchasing_settings WHERE organization_id=_org;
    IF COALESCE(v_segregation,true) AND o.created_by=auth.uid() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não é possível aprovar o próprio pedido (segregação).'; END IF;
    UPDATE public.purchase_orders SET status='APPROVED',approved_by=auth.uid(),approved_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE id=_id;
  ELSIF _action='send' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.companies c JOIN public.supplier_profiles s ON s.company_id=c.id WHERE s.id=o.supplier_id AND (c.status='ACTIVE' AND s.status='ACTIVE')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Fornecedor inativo ou bloqueado.'; END IF;
    IF o.status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_APPROVAL') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido precisa ser aprovado antes de ser enviado.'; END IF;
    IF o.status NOT IN ('APPROVED','SENT') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Estado inválido para envio.'; END IF;
    UPDATE public.purchase_orders SET status='SENT',sent_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE id=_id;
  ELSIF _action='cancel' THEN
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.goods_receipts WHERE purchase_order_id=_id AND status IN ('POSTED','ACCEPTED')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido com recebimentos; cancele-os antes.'; END IF;
    IF o.status='COMPLETED' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido concluído não pode ser cancelado.'; END IF;
    UPDATE public.purchase_orders SET status='CANCELED',updated_at=now() WHERE id=_id;
    UPDATE public.purchase_order_items SET status='CANCELED' WHERE purchase_order_id=_id;
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.purchasing_audit(_org,'purchasing.order.'||_action,'purchase_orders',_id,_data);
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id',_id,'status',CASE _action WHEN 'submit' THEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL' WHEN 'approve' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN 'send' THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'CANCELED' END);
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.po_query(_org uuid,_kind text,_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}',_page integer DEFAULT 1)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE result jsonb; query text:=lower(coalesce(_filters->>'query','')); status text:=coalesce(_filters->>'status','');
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.purchasing_require(_org,'purchase_orders.read');
  IF _kind='orders' THEN
    WITH rows AS MATERIALIZED(
      SELECT po.id,po.order_number,po.status,po.issue_date,po.expected_delivery_date,po.currency,po.total_amount,po.payment_terms,po.subtotal,
        c.legal_name supplier_name,c.id company_id,sp.supplier_code,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.purchase_order_items i WHERE i.purchase_order_id=po.id) items,
        (SELECT sum(ordered_quantity) FROM public.purchase_order_items i WHERE i.purchase_order_id=po.id) ordered_qty,
        (SELECT sum(received_quantity) FROM public.purchase_order_items i WHERE i.purchase_order_id=po.id) received_qty
      FROM public.purchase_orders po JOIN public.supplier_profiles sp ON sp.id=po.supplier_id JOIN public.companies c ON c.id=sp.company_id
      WHERE po.organization_id=_org)
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)) FROM (SELECT * FROM rows WHERE (query='' OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',order_number,supplier_name)),query)>0) AND (status='' OR status=rows_status) ORDER BY issue_date DESC,order_number DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET (_page-1)*50) q),'[]'::jsonb),'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM rows)) INTO result;
  ELSIF _kind='order' THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('order',(SELECT to_jsonb(po) FROM public.purchase_orders po WHERE po.id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid AND po.organization_id=_org),
      'items',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(i),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT poi.*,v.sku,pr.name product_name,pu.code purchase_unit,iu.code inventory_unit FROM public.purchase_order_items poi JOIN public.product_variants v ON v.id=poi.variant_id JOIN public.products pr ON pr.id=v.product_id LEFT JOIN public.units_of_measure pu ON pu.id=poi.purchase_unit_id LEFT JOIN public.units_of_measure iu ON iu.id=poi.inventory_unit_id WHERE poi.purchase_order_id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid ORDER BY v.sku) i),
      'receipts',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(r),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT gr.id,gr.receipt_number,gr.status,gr.received_at,gr.total_received,gr.total_accepted,gr.total_rejected FROM public.goods_receipts gr WHERE gr.purchase_order_id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid ORDER BY gr.created_at) r),
      'documents',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(d),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT sd.id,sd.document_type,sd.document_number,sd.issue_date,sd.total_amount,sd.status FROM public.supplier_documents sd WHERE sd.purchase_order_id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid ORDER BY sd.created_at) d),
      'exceptions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(e),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT pe.id,pe.exception_type,pe.severity,pe.status,pe.message FROM public.purchase_exceptions pe WHERE pe.purchase_order_id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid AND pe.status IN ('OPEN','IN_REVIEW') ORDER BY pe.created_at) e),
      'payables',CASE WHEN public.has_permission(_org,'payables.read') THEN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(p),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT ap.id,ap.document_number,ap.source_type,ap.source_status,ap.issue_date,ap.due_date,ap.original_amount,ap.open_amount,ap.status,ap.installment_number,ap.total_installments FROM public.account_payables ap WHERE ap.source_type='PURCHASE' AND ap.organization_id=_org AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.goods_receipts gr WHERE gr.id::text=ap.source_id AND gr.purchase_order_id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_documents sd WHERE sd.id::text=ap.source_id AND sd.purchase_order_id=(_filters->>'id')::uuid)) ORDER BY ap.due_date) p) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) INTO result;
  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Consulta inválida.'; END IF;
  RETURN result;
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.purchasing_find_factor(_org uuid,_from uuid,_to uuid) RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
 SELECT COALESCE((SELECT c.factor FROM public.unit_conversions c WHERE (c.organization_id=_org OR c.organization_id IS NULL) AND c.from_unit_id=_from AND c.to_unit_id=_to ORDER BY c.organization_id NULLS LAST,created_at DESC,id LIMIT 1),
                 (SELECT 1/c.factor FROM public.unit_conversions c WHERE (c.organization_id=_org OR c.organization_id IS NULL) AND c.from_unit_id=_to AND c.to_unit_id=_from ORDER BY c.organization_id NULLS LAST,created_at DESC,id LIMIT 1));
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.receipt_save(_org uuid,_data jsonb) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE v uuid:=gen_random_uuid(); it jsonb; po_id uuid:=(_data->>'purchase_order_id')::uuid; v_supplier uuid; v_loc uuid;
  v_po_status text; v_qty numeric; v_cost numeric; v_factor numeric; v_total numeric:=0; v_batch uuid;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.purchasing_require(_org,'goods_receipts.create');
  PERFORM public.inventory_lock(_org);
  SELECT status,supplier_id,destination_location_id INTO v_po_status,v_supplier,v_loc FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id=po_id AND organization_id=_org;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido não encontrado.'; END IF;
  IF v_po_status NOT IN ('APPROVED','SENT','RECEIVING') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido não está em estado de recebimento.'; END IF;
  v_supplier:=coalesce(nullif(_data->>'supplier_id','')::uuid,v_supplier);
  v_loc:=coalesce(nullif(_data->>'destination_location_id','')::uuid,v_loc);
  IF v_loc IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_locations WHERE id=v_loc AND organization_id=_org) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Localização de destino obrigatória.'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.goods_receipts(organization_id,receipt_number,purchase_order_id,supplier_id,destination_location_id,received_at,received_by,status,supplier_document_number,notes)
  VALUES(_org,'GR-'||to_char(now(),'YYYY')||'-'||lpad(nextval('public.goods_receipt_seq')::text,6,'0'),po_id,v_supplier,v_loc,coalesce(nullif(_data->>'received_at','')::date,CURRENT_DATE),auth.uid(),'DRAFT',_data->>'supplier_document_number',_data->>'notes')
  RETURNING id INTO v;
  FOR it IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(_data->'items')
  LOOP
    v_qty:=(it->>'quantity')::numeric;
    IF v_qty<=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quantidade recebida inválida.'; END IF;
    v_cost:=coalesce((it->>'unit_cost')::numeric,0);
    -- Conversão oficial compra -> estoque quando as unidades diferem.
    v_factor:=1;
    IF nullif(it->>'purchase_unit_id','') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(it->>'inventory_unit_id','') IS NOT NULL AND (it->>'purchase_unit_id')::uuid<>(it->>'inventory_unit_id')::uuid THEN
      v_factor:=public.purchasing_find_factor(_org,(it->>'purchase_unit_id')::uuid,(it->>'inventory_unit_id')::uuid);
      IF v_factor IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conversão de unidade não configurada (UNIT_CONVERSION_MISSING) entre as unidades informadas.';
      END IF;
      IF (it->>'purchase_quantity') IS NOT NULL AND abs(round(((it->>'purchase_quantity')::numeric)*v_factor,3)-v_qty)>0.001 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quantidade informada divergente da conversão de unidade configurada.';
      END IF;
    END IF;
    v_batch:=nullif(it->>'batch_id','')::uuid;
    IF v_batch IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_batches WHERE id=v_batch AND organization_id=_org) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Lote inválido.'; END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.goods_receipt_items(organization_id,goods_receipt_id,purchase_order_item_id,variant_id,received_quantity,accepted_quantity,rejected_quantity,inventory_unit_id,purchase_unit_id,conversion_factor,unit_cost,line_total,batch_id,manufacture_date,expiration_date,reason,status)
    VALUES(_org,v,(it->>'purchase_order_item_id')::uuid,(it->>'variant_id')::uuid,v_qty,0,0,nullif(it->>'inventory_unit_id','')::uuid,nullif(it->>'purchase_unit_id','')::uuid,CASE WHEN v_factor<>1 THEN v_factor END,v_cost,round(v_qty*v_cost,6),v_batch,nullif(it->>'manufacture_date','')::date,nullif(it->>'expiration_date','')::date,it->>'reason','RECEIVED');
    v_total:=v_total+round(v_qty*v_cost,6);
  END LOOP;
  UPDATE public.goods_receipts SET total_received=v_total,total_accepted=0,total_rejected=0 WHERE id=v;
  PERFORM public.purchasing_audit(_org,'purchasing.receipt.create','goods_receipts',v,_data);
  RETURN v;
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.receipt_action(_org uuid,_id uuid,_action text,_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}') RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE r public.goods_receipts; it jsonb; item public.goods_receipt_items; poi public.purchase_order_items;
  v_qty numeric; v_ordered numeric; v_remaining numeric; v_accepted numeric; v_over numeric;
  v_policy text; v_count integer:=0; v_rej public.goods_receipt_items; v_tot_a numeric:=0; v_tot_r numeric:=0;
  v_settings public.purchasing_settings; v_movement_count integer:=0; v_po_status text; v_all_received boolean; v_receipt_item public.goods_receipt_items;
  v_conv_missing boolean:=false; v_po_total numeric;
BEGIN
  IF _action NOT IN ('inspect','post','cancel') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ação inválida.'; END IF;
  PERFORM public.purchasing_require(_org,CASE _action WHEN 'post' THEN 'goods_receipts.post' WHEN 'cancel' THEN 'goods_receipts.cancel' ELSE 'goods_receipts.inspect' END);
  PERFORM public.inventory_lock(_org);
  SELECT * INTO r FROM public.goods_receipts WHERE id=_id AND organization_id=_org FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recebimento não encontrado.'; END IF;
  IF _action='inspect' THEN
    IF r.status NOT IN ('DRAFT','UNDER_INSPECTION','REJECTED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Estado inválido para inspeção.'; END IF;
    PERFORM public.purchasing_ensure_settings(_org);
    SELECT * INTO v_settings FROM public.purchasing_settings WHERE organization_id=_org;
    FOR item IN SELECT * FROM public.goods_receipt_items WHERE goods_receipt_id=_id ORDER BY id
    LOOP
      v_accepted:=item.received_quantity;
      FOR it IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(_data->'items','[]'::jsonb))
      LOOP
        IF (it->>'purchase_order_item_id')::uuid=item.purchase_order_item_id THEN
          v_accepted:=coalesce((it->>'accepted_quantity')::numeric,item.received_quantity);
        END IF;
      END LOOP;
      IF v_accepted<0 OR v_accepted>item.received_quantity THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quantidade aceita inválida.'; END IF;
      SELECT * INTO poi FROM public.purchase_order_items WHERE id=item.purchase_order_item_id;
      v_remaining:=poi.ordered_quantity-poi.received_quantity;
      v_over:=round(v_accepted-v_remaining,3);
      IF v_over>0 AND v_settings.over_receipt_policy='BLOCK' AND NOT public.has_permission(_org,'purchase_exceptions.resolve') THEN
        INSERT INTO public.purchase_exceptions(organization_id,exception_type,severity,status,purchase_order_id,purchase_order_item_id,goods_receipt_id,variant_id,message,details)
        VALUES(_org,'OVER_RECEIPT','WARNING','OPEN',r.purchase_order_id,item.purchase_order_item_id,_id,item.variant_id,'Quantidade recebida excede o pedido.',
          jsonb_build_object('received',item.received_quantity,'remaining',v_remaining,'excess',v_over));
        v_accepted:=round(v_remaining,3);
        IF v_accepted<0 THEN v_accepted:=0; END IF;
      ELSIF v_over>0 THEN
        INSERT INTO public.purchase_exceptions(organization_id,exception_type,severity,status,purchase_order_id,purchase_order_item_id,goods_receipt_id,variant_id,message,details,resolved_by,resolved_at,resolution_notes)
        VALUES(_org,'OVER_RECEIPT','WARNING','RESOLVED',r.purchase_order_id,item.purchase_order_item_id,_id,item.variant_id,'Excesso autorizado em recebimento.',
          jsonb_build_object('received',item.received_quantity,'remaining',v_remaining,'excess',v_over),auth.uid(),now(),'Política AUTH_OVERRIDE ou permissão de resolução.');
      END IF;
      UPDATE public.goods_receipt_items SET accepted_quantity=v_accepted,rejected_quantity=round(item.received_quantity-v_accepted,3),status=CASE WHEN v_accepted=0 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN v_accepted<item.received_quantity THEN 'ACCEPTED' ELSE 'ACCEPTED' END WHERE id=item.id;
      v_tot_a:=v_tot_a+v_accepted; v_tot_r:=v_tot_r+round(item.received_quantity-v_accepted,3);
    END LOOP;
    v_count:=(SELECT count(*) FROM public.goods_receipt_items WHERE goods_receipt_id=_id);

    v_id:=(v_data->>v_pair[1])::uuid;
    IF v_id IS NULL THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
    EXECUTE format('SELECT organization_id FROM public.%I WHERE id=$1',v_pair[2]) INTO v_org USING v_id;
    IF v_org IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.organization_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Referência fora da organização.'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- Guarda: histórico imutável; escrita sempre via RPC.
CREATE FUNCTION public.purchasing_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
DECLARE v_status text; j jsonb:=to_jsonb(NEW);
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Histórico não pode ser excluído.'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.organization_id<>OLD.organization_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Organização imutável.'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='goods_receipts' AND OLD.status IN ('POSTED','CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recebimento postado/cancelado é imutável.'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='goods_receipt_items' THEN
    SELECT status INTO v_status FROM public.goods_receipts WHERE id=(j->>'goods_receipt_id')::uuid;
    IF v_status IN ('POSTED','CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Item de recebimento imutável após postagem.'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='supplier_returns' AND OLD.status IN ('POSTED','CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Devolução postada/cancelada é imutável.'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='supplier_return_items' THEN
    SELECT status INTO v_status FROM public.supplier_returns WHERE id=(j->>'supplier_return_id')::uuid;
    IF v_status IN ('POSTED','CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Item de devolução imutável após postagem.'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='supplier_documents' AND OLD.status IN ('PROCESSED','CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Documento processado/cancelado é imutável.'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='purchase_orders' AND OLD.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pedido concluído/cancelado é imutável.'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='purchase_exceptions' AND OLD.status IN ('RESOLVED','IGNORED_WITH_AUTHORIZATION') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exceção resolvida é imutável.'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;
